svg.title: How PrefillAdder admits requests
svg.desc: 5 · A wrong guess: decode runs out of slots and retracts
svg.text: 5 · A wrong guess: decode runs out of slots and retracts
KV pool slots of one GPU · page_size 1
check_decode_mem() fails, so retract_decode() releases requests until decode fits.
Default order: short output and long input first · they go back to waiting_queue.
new_token_ratio jumps to (decoded + 20 × requests) / Σ max_new_tokens, capped at 1.
